0022600196.text: The 76ers (8-2), first in the Atlantic and first in the East, come into this 11th game of their season on a one-game losing streak after a 4-1 road record, and they are without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture). The Bulls (1-7) are 14th in the East and fourth in the Central, five games back, and have lost six straight, with Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness) both out. The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 126-107 win in Philadelphia, though they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
